Array.Add

Array

Add

Available since version 8.0.

Syntax:

Add(<Value>)

Parameters:

<Value> (optional)

Type: Arbitrary.
Added value. If not specified, a value of Undefined type will be added.

Description:

Adds an element to the end of the array.

Availability:

Thin client, web-client, mobile client, server, thick client, external connection, mobile application (client), mobile application (server), mobile standalone server.

Note:

When an element is added, the number of elements in the array is increased by 1.

Example:

Array.Add("First");
Array.Add("Second");

Available since:

Available since version 8.0.
